text: Built by Sanjay Das, Ethan Seefried, Chris Kellogg, Tahisha Jain, and Nafiza Shazia Aviedi. The project used NVIDIA ALCHEMI, Sonnet, and fine-tuned NVIDIA Nemotron Bolt; Claude and GPT Sol supported the build. We thank Claude for $100 in API support for building the project, separate from reported experiment-cost estimates. The quantum report does not isolate ALCHEMI’s performance contribution.
